'''Hok''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. The planet was split into two sides. One side was the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] wasteland that looked like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while the other half was surrounded by pure darkness. This area also had a rich supply of [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on which the people [[Mine/Legends|mined]] and traded.

It was established as a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colony in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] during an expansion period. However, the emigrating colonists left a significant imbalance in Gran society on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. Feeling they were destroying too many families, and diluting the Gran race, the government reacted with isolationist policies and prohibited unauthorized emigration from Kinyen and limited offworlders to special [[Alien/Legends|alien]] quarters in their cities.

This protected the Gran society, but it also isolated the Gran on Hok and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] who had begun to form strong bonds to their new homes. The Gran colonies continued independently, continuing the strong social bonds of Gran society but with loosened social codes. The looser social codes allowed for more corruption in the upper levels of colonial Gran society.

The famed Gran [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]] was a native of this world.
